finding: With equal true supports and equal total function variance, reallocation improves over addition with positive nominal paired intervals in four of five learned-prior 24-batch groups; the shared group interval crosses zero.
interpretation: Supports studying target-dependent covariance allocation; does not establish learnable support, removal as the sole cause, or decision gains. Original source component intercepts, means and discrepancy are retained.
remaining_failures: Shared/52 and separate-risk/61 reallocation predictions still lose relative to the old model.
